questions.question_text: Which video editing software is free, beginner-friendly, and ideal for quick social media content like TikTok or Instagram Reels?
What is the main purpose of trimming a video clip during editing?

options.text: To remove an entire section from the middle of the clip
To shorten a clip by adjusting its start or end points for better pacing
To add special effects between two clips
To overlay text or graphics on the video

correct_answer.text: To shorten a clip by adjusting its start or end points for better pacing

questions.question_text: Why is Colour grading used in video editing, and how can it impact your content?

options.text: It fixes audio issues to make voices clearer
It adjusts brightness and contrast to correct lighting mistakes
It stylizes the video with specific Colour tones to create a mood or cinematic look
It adds text and graphics for better storytelling

correct_answer.text: It stylizes the video with specific Colour tones to create a mood or cinematic look

questions.question_text: When adding audio to a video, what should you consider to avoid copyright issues on platforms like YouTube or TikTok?

options.text: Use any popular song as long as it’s trending
Always add your own recorded music without checking platform rules
Choose royalty-free music from app libraries or use platform-approved sounds
Keep the music volume high to cover any copyright claims

correct_answer.text: Choose royalty-free music from app libraries or use platform-approved sounds
